notes.title: About bonuses
notes.content:
We decided that there would be 3 bonuses in our game:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/38e30976e87bec86161d09762d05420f562fbac0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/08438501a97ff7f8608a8b97b4b087dfc54d4608.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/16e222707c84119556fc6bd824f72ac132fc69ac.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/a95d8347bd8160492b2ebe19528af47e37480d17.png[/img][/url]
Speed up and slow down of the game - so you can choose a comfortable game speed.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/115ce32264e9639b38cf080803ea22c4ba6c1a19.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/952f59a9ab5b5def3a38023e22b0ceb4a9f344ff.png[/img][/url]
And call a new train. The main goal of the game is to deliver a certain number of trains in a limited time. This bonus can help you if you don't have enough time.

notes.title: Everything is almost ready. We are working now on the game balance
notes.content:
The game should be fun to play - it should not be too simple or too complex. This is especially true for puzzles.
So we try to configure it properly.

Our uncle is watching the process
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/1cd18c7cc78717e753568208327cf1611d38ff16.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35443837/bc25189607b8577bc54a568d73ff99a3d12471a1.png[/img][/url]
